result.summary: The image shows an urban street with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. Pedestrians are visible crossing the street, which features embedded tracks in the roadway and lacks signalized control at this intersection.

hazards.name: Embedded tracks
hazards.description: Tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians or catch bicycle wheels.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway running parallel to traffic.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians are crossing a multi-lane street without the protection of a traffic signal or stop sign.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: A vehicle is parked or stopped close to the crosswalk, potentially obscuring pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: White SUV approaching the crosswalk from the background.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to alert drivers to the presence of people in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and prioritize pedestrian movement.

result.summary: The image shows a multi-lane urban street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a signalized intersection. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the significant crossing distance across four lanes without a median refuge increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Unprotected Multi-lane Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic at once without a refuge island, increasing exposure time and the risk of multi-threat crashes.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles stopped or parked near the intersection can block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with sidewalks, street lighting, and a bus shelter. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide roadway with trolley tracks and lack of physical crossing protection increases exposure risk.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and pose a tripping hazard for pedestrians or a crash risk for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending into the foreground

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and the bus shelter structure may partially block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the intersection

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicular traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard transverse markings to high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban intersection featuring high-visibility continental crosswalks and signalized pedestrian crossings. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the environment lacks physical buffers such as trees or a median refuge, leaving pedestrians exposed over a significant crossing distance.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide expanse of asphalt without a mid-point refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway at the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of physical buffer
hazards.description: There is no vertical separation or greenery between the sidewalk and the moving traffic lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line on both sides of the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the crosswalk to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add vegetation along the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.
